title: Dalekanium Redux
body:
### **Dalekanium Redux**

**Description:**  
Dalekanium Redux is a texture pack designed for *Teab’s Doctor Who Mod* that gives the Dalekanium tools and armor a complete visual overhaul to match the style of *The Dalek Mod*.  

**Features:**  
- Full Dalekanium toolset and armor textures reimagined in The Dalek Mod's style.  
- Custom textures for tools not included in The Dalek Mod’s original Dalekanium lineup, designed to complement existing visuals.  
- Smooth integration for an enhanced Doctor Who-themed Minecraft experience.  

**Compatibility:**  
- Compatible with the latest version of *Teab’s Doctor Who Mod*.  

**Installation:**  
1. Download Dalekanium Redux from Modrinth.  
2. Place the .zip file into your resource packs folder.  
3. Enable it in the Minecraft settings, above the original texture pack.  

Embrace the best of both mods with a unified look for Dalekanium!  

> *Exterminate the default textures—stylishly!*  

**Please support [Teab’s Doctor Who Mod](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/teabs-doctor-who-mod) and [The Dalek Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/dalek-mod/versions).**
